## Reading

The native clip mask now carries fractional coverage (`mid > 0`):
`rasterizeClipMask` supersamples the path and `clipCov` multiplies the
coverage into the fill alpha. The clipped edge therefore has the same
kind of AA ramp as the reference, and the gate passes.

The seam is closed; keep this trace as the regression instrument for
clip-path AA. The next seam is the compiler's realization report.
